title: What The Wind Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist Perth Zimbabwe wind ocean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The wind is the oldest thing still moving — it predates the ground
It was there before the first thing that it moved around
The wind has been to every place and left its record there
In the angle of the trees and in the texture of the air

[Pre-Chorus]
I have watched the wind in Perth come off the Indian Ocean flat
And understood precisely why my father and the bat
Trees grew at the particular angle that they did
And why the fence went down in August — that's what it is

[Chorus]
What does the wind know that I don't know?
It knows every coastline and every corridor below
What does the wind know from three thousand metres?
It knows the temperature of every continent and its features
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The fremantle doctor is the afternoon sea breeze specific
To the Perth coast — a wind with a name and a terrific
Reputation for arriving at three and cooling everything
The wind in Perth is expected and the whole city knows its ring

[Bridge]
The Zimbabwe wind in October was the hot dry thing
That came before the rains and said the season's happening
Now — and you'd feel it in the afternoon and know
The msasa was already turning red and the rains would flow

[Outro]
Wind knows… every place it's been… every tree it's shaped…
That's my boy
